title: Migrate from the legacy Charges API to PaymentIntents
summary: Stripe's legacy Charges API is deprecated for new payment integrations. Create and confirm a PaymentIntent instead, which supports Strong Customer Authentication and modern payment methods, and read the PaymentIntent status instead of charge.paid.
migrationSteps: Pass amount, currency and customer as before; rename source to payment_method.
Set confirm: true so the payment is created and confirmed in one call, and add automatic_payment_methods: { enabled: true, allow_redirects: "never" } for server-side confirmation.
Determine success with paymentIntent.status === "succeeded" instead of charge.paid, and return paymentIntent.id instead of charge.id.
